t: Vietnam was reunified as a socialist republic on 2 July 1976, a year after the fall of Saigon, with Hanoi as capital.
Wars with Cambodia and China and failed collectivisation left it isolated and poor until the Doi Moi reforms of 1986.
Under one-party rule it became a major exporter of rice, coffee and electronics and a significant Asian middle power.
dyk: Within three years of the Doi Moi reforms, Vietnam turned from a country that had to import rice into one of the world’s largest rice exporters.
ev: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam is proclaimed and Saigon renamed Ho Chi Minh City
Vietnam invades Cambodia and overthrows the Khmer Rouge in January 1979
China attacks across the northern border in the Sino-Vietnamese War
The Sixth Party Congress adopts the Doi Moi market reforms
The last Vietnamese troops withdraw from Cambodia
Vietnam normalises relations with the United States and joins ASEAN
Vietnam joins the World Trade Organization
Ties with the United States are raised to a comprehensive strategic partnership

f.founder: Communist Party of Vietnam (Le Duan, Pham Van Dong)
f.predecessor: Democratic Republic of Vietnam; Republic of South Vietnam
